subject.title: feat: add portable table presentation blocks

question: Should `table` become a supported public portable presentation block in the shipped plugin SDK with Slack-native rendering and deterministic fallback elsewhere?
rationale: The PR establishes a permanent external API and cross-channel semantic contract; code correctness alone cannot choose or approve that product boundary.

options.title: Adopt portable tables
options.body: Approve the public table shape and merge only after live Slack proof and final exact-head gates pass.

options.title: Keep tables Slack-private
options.body: Avoid expanding the shared SDK and retain native table support only through Slack-owned payloads.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep the canonical structured-message issue open while designing a smaller or more general structured-data contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt portable tables
recommendation.body: Approve the public table shape and merge only after live Slack proof and final exact-head gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main provenance ties this person most directly to the shared portable presentation API and central Slack implementation.
